name: IC Analog Audio — ST
description: Analog audio IC cluster featuring surface-mount (SMD) components in ST package footprints, including ST_PowerSSO-24_SlugDown.
selection_hints: Select when designing analog audio circuits requiring surface-mount (SMD) ICs.
Use when the PCB layout accommodates ST package footprints like ST_PowerSSO-24_SlugDown.
Choose when sourcing Tier A analog audio components such as TDA7266P.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole (THT) mounting rather than surface-mount (SMD).
The PCB layout requires footprints other than ST_PowerSSO-24_SlugDown.
The application requires digital audio processing or non-audio ICs.
